description: Natural Resources Canada and Aquanty publish a regional integrated groundwater and surface-water model for the Carcajou Watershed in the Northwest Territories. The Data in Brief article describes a HydroGeoSphere project with command files, daily transient climate forcing, bedrock rasters, hydroconditioned terrain and stream network inputs, arranged in a public model archive. The Open Canada catalogue names the model and provides Shapefile, ASCII-grid and 3D model files plus GIS service links under the Open Government Licence - Canada. A HEAD request confirmed that the 339-megabyte CRW.7z archive is reachable without downloading it. The model is intended to test permafrost representations and climate effects on water resources in a gauged basin, not to represent all Canadian watersheds. Simplified channel selection, local calibration and proprietary HydroGeoSphere dependencies are limitations for direct transfer. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing conceptualisations of integrated permafrost hydrology under alternate forcing. data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins is a related hydrographic source, but no shared model input was established. The archive was not opened or run.
